mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Yield curve inverts (10y-2y < 0) within the next 6 months, or SPX posts negative 60-day returns in > 40% of quarters with YoY GDP acceleration.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM manufacturing index (proxied by INDPRO) falls below 45, it signals a contraction in industrial activity that will weigh on economic growth and produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX posts positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO < 45, or INDPRO mean-reverts above 50 within 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) over a 3-month period signals a rapidly weakening labor market that will depress consumer spending and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX posts positive 5-day returns in > 70% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 3 months, or UNRATE mean-reverts lower within 2 months.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) rises above 4%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy stance that will slow economic growth and produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX posts positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4%, or FEDFUNDS cuts by > 50bp within 6 months.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) both decline month-over-month, it signals a weakening consumer sector that will drag on economic growth and produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX posts positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline MoM, or both series mean-revert higher within 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM manufacturing index (proxied by INDPRO) rises above 55 and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4%, it signals a tight labor market and supply constraints that will boost inflation and produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX posts positive 60-day returns in > 50% of instances when INDPRO > 55 and UNRATE < 4%, or both conditions reverse within 6 months.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3% YoY and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 2%, it signals an inflationary regime that will erode real returns and produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX posts positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3% and FEDFUNDS < 2%, or both conditions reverse within 6 months.

mechanism_narrative: When payroll employment (PAYEMS) declines month-over-month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises above 6%, it signals a weakening labor market that will depress consumer spending and produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX posts positive 5-day returns in > 70% of instances when PAYEMS declines MoM and UNRATE > 6%, or both conditions reverse within 3 months.
